entries.headline: Silver deliveries pick back up: 120 contracts on Oct 13
entries.moved: 120 October silver (SI) contracts were issued and stopped.
entries.amount: About 600,000 oz (120 × 5,000 oz). October month-to-date: 3,250 contracts, about 16.25M oz.
entries.context: A rebound from just 1 contract on Oct 9 and 4 on Oct 12. Registered silver still rose over the same stretch, so new deposits outpaced delivery draws.
entries.source: Heavy Metal Stats (CME Group daily delivery notices)

entries.headline: Registered silver climbs to 103.35M oz
entries.moved: COMEX registered (deliverable) silver rose 593.8K oz in one day.
entries.amount: 103.35M oz registered, up about 7.8% over 30 days (from about 96.5M oz in mid-September).
entries.context: Registered is now about 31% of total COMEX silver. The trend has been steady additions, not drawdowns.
entries.source: The Vault Report (CME Group daily warehouse stocks)

entries.headline: Eligible silver down about 7.8M oz in a week and a half
entries.moved: Eligible (stored, not deliverable) silver fell from 236.49M oz (Oct 2) to 228.66M oz (Oct 12).
entries.amount: About -7.8M oz (-3.3%). Total COMEX silver fell from 338.17M to 332.01M oz.
entries.context: Part of this offsets registered gains (metal re-classified as deliverable); the rest is net metal leaving COMEX vaults.
entries.source: The Vault Report (CME Group daily warehouse stocks)

entries.headline: Two-day silver delivery burst: 688 contracts on Oct 7–8
entries.moved: 330 SI contracts issued/stopped on Oct 7 and 358 on Oct 8.
entries.context: The busiest stretch of the October silver delivery month so far. It came as settlement dipped just under $60 and faded once prices rebounded.

entries.headline: Gold notices spike to 785, mostly micro contracts
entries.moved: 785 gold notices on Oct 8: 255 standard 100-oz (GC) and 530 Micro Gold.
entries.amount: About 25,500 oz from standard contracts plus about 5,300 oz from micros (10 oz each).
entries.context: Standard October gold month-to-date reached 12,329 contracts. Daily pace then slowed to 138 (Oct 9), 44 (Oct 12) and 1 (Oct 13).

entries.headline: 1,021 gold notices on Oct 2, led by 860 Micro Gold
entries.moved: 161 standard GC and 860 Micro Gold contracts issued/stopped.
entries.amount: About 16,100 oz standard plus about 8,600 oz micro.
entries.context: The largest single-day notice count of early October, driven by smaller-size micro contracts. Registered gold stayed roughly flat near 15.1M oz (-0.5% over 30 days).
entries.source: Arc Research (CME Group delivery notices); MetalCharts for registered gold

entries.headline: Registered silver jumps 5.3M oz in two days
entries.moved: Registered silver rose 2.92M oz on Sep 28 and 2.36M oz on Sep 29.
entries.context: The move that pushed registered silver back above 100M oz, timed around the end of the September delivery month.
entries.source: The Vault Report (CME Group daily warehouse stocks)
